expeditions.name: The Goblin Shift
expeditions.description: One hour's shift on a canyon claim with the goblin crew. They count every stroke out loud and split the take by whoever is still swinging at the bell — so she keeps up, does not go shy, and does not complain about the crowd.

expeditions.name: Wet Cargo
expeditions.description: Six drums of water up to the rim camps before the heat turns the road to glass. The orc crews there have been dry a week, and she names her own price — they have no coin, and pay in the only currency they have.

expeditions.name: Line Them Up
expeditions.description: Down at the canyon checkpoint for the hour the goblin crews come off shift. Every last one of them gets checked before he goes home, and she is the one holding the whip — nobody steps out of that line without her say-so.

expeditions.name: Posted Alone
expeditions.description: Down the caravan route, scouting the waystations one at a time. Every man posted on that road has been alone for a season, and each gets the same treatment: water checked, lines of sight checked, and she stays as long as he needs her.

expeditions.name: Dig It Out
expeditions.description: Dig out a shaft the old crews sealed and walked away from — three hours of it, with the orcs on the next claim working the same seam and getting nowhere. Whatever is down there was buried for a reason.

expeditions.name: Writ, Served Warm
expeditions.description: Out into the badlands to serve a writ on a name crossed out and rewritten twice. The office pays by what she brings back, and the mark is only worth the fee — so she takes whatever else she wants off him first, then brings him in.

expeditions.name: Still Shored, Still Hung
expeditions.description: Down a claim nobody has refiled in nine years. The shaft is still shored, the lamps still hung, the tools where the last crew set them down mid-shift — anything she finds is hers, anything still standing is left standing.

expeditions.name: Stripped To The Frame
expeditions.description: Into the desert wreck field to bring the medic back what she needs. Nothing comes home unless it is stripped to the frame, and every piece gets handed over in person — she has firm opinions about how salvage is presented to her.

expeditions.name: Don't Sing Back
expeditions.description: Out with a wagon train on the dune roads. The captain wants somebody awake who will not sing back at whatever sings out there, and who is willing to keep the men warm in the wagons instead — nothing else out here does.

expeditions.name: Headfirst
expeditions.description: Down into a flooded canyon slot, searching for the shipment the last flash flood took under. The hole is narrow, she goes in headfirst and keeps going, and the canyon does not care what it does to her — it has taken three crews.
